dct_creator_sm: Sinnett, Charles (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: Georeferenced map of Katzie Nation reserves Katzie 1 and Katzie 2 located on opposite banks in the Fraser River near the fork with Barnston Island. Katzie 1 has an "Indian" village and garden; Katzie 2 has an "Indian" village, burial grounds, and potato patches. Surveyed and drawn by Charles Sinnett, 24 August 1861. [Not signed by Superintendent of Indian Affairs.]
